items.title: Demon Fire
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Demons charged by fire! These skins are hot and fiery. Shine bright like an inferno and be a blast in any world!

items.title: Devil Kids
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Sometimes kids are just little devils. This time they're literally devil kids! These devious little rascals are up to no good!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Cute and fun attire inspired by devils!

items.title: Dimensions Parkour
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
You've fallen from Space and into another dimension. Or, even better, mini-dimensions everywhere! Explore a grid-style parkour adventure! Explore each uniquely themed section!

* Multiplayer Friendly!
* Great map to learn parkour on!

items.title: DREAM GLITCHES
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Dream Glitches are breaking free from their dimension to ravage the Minecraft world!

7 HD skins (128px) including:

- 1 exclusive free skin by: Dannny0117
- 6 colorful glitch skins

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Teen Gods
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
This skin pack represents different gods as teens and young warriors. Each of them is a keeper of their realm and power, as gods, they have duties and also they have the power to transform land itself. Even mobs are horrified when attacking them. Choose your favorite skin and join the game as a powerful teen!

+ Anime style
+ Medieval
+ Fantasy
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Halloween Horror
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
One night per year these monsters can reveal themselves to spook people. Scary and dark entities with the only purpose - to bring horror. Gather up with friends choose your monsters and spook other players!

+ Halloween
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Halloween Night Party
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Are you ready for the Halloween night party!? These skins are a perfect fit for your party, choose your favorite, change them whenever you want, and share with friends! A bit creepy, lovely, and tailored costumes special for you!

+ Halloween
+ Scary
+ Creepy
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: NEW MODERN TEENS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
The simplistic style has all the rage! Grab the NEW MODERN TEENS and live the minimalistic lifestyle!

+ Includes 14 teen skins
+ Modern style

items.title: Escape The Island
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
You are stuck on 8 floating islands! Complete all parkour to activate the beacons, which opens up the portal that brings you down safely!

- 7 parkours with a wide variety of jumps and rewards!
- Epic cinematic for completing all parkour with custom music!
- Usable survival world after you complete the parkours!
+ 15 skins included!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Baby Dinos
items.creator: Starfish Studios
items.description:
Dinosaurs have NEVER BEEN CUTER. Explore the island and care for lots of adorable BABY DINOSAURS. Tame them, give them CUTE outfits, or even give them a saddle to ride or fly with them! 

+ T-Rex Island, with 6 different biomes!
+ 16x Baby dinosaurs 
+ 8x Cute skins

items.title: Halloween Fiends
items.creator: Mike Gaboury
items.description:
Join up with the Halloween fiends in their attempt to win a costume contest!

Featuring the following costumes:
-Creeper
-Zombie Piglin
-Enraged Enderman
-Zombie
-Werewolf

items.title: Cottagecore: Fall
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Get ready for Fall fashion with the 'Cottagecore: Fall' skinset! Bundle up nice and warm and be ready for the new season!

- 8 autumn fashion skins!
- With many different outfits to pick from, you can find the perfect one for you!

items.title: Cyber Skins
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
'Cyber Skins' has just hit the shelves! Be sure to catch everyone's attention with these brightly colored designs! 

- 8 abstract skins!
- Pick between a wide range of color combinations and patterns, and find the perfect one for you!

items.title: Magic School
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These young wizards have a lot to learn, luckily they're in the right place... Magic School!

- 8 skins!
- Perfect for any magic fan!
- Pick from a wide variety of robe and skin designs and find the one that matches you best!

items.title: Millionaire Resort
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description: Millionaire Resort is a survival spawn of luxury! From fun rooms to a beautiful pool, this resort has tons of stuff for you to share with your friends!

items.title: Skyblock!
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description: Skyblock! is a challenge map! Survive and challenge the Warden in Skyblock! for 1.19!

items.title: Hidden Blocks
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Camouflage yourself among your friends with these hidden blocks to fool them! You will be invisible among all of them to play pranks and they will never know who you are!

+ 12 hidden skins
+ By iRay

items.title: PvP Style
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Need to look good for your next PvP battle? This pack was made for you! The latest styles in this pack will make sure to make your enemies jealous. These skins are also perfect for roleplay!

+ 10 inclusive skins for everyone!
+ Multiple style types
+ Trendy skins

items.title: Gamers
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Gamers are back in business and they're crushing the competition! It just keeps getting better! Gamers for life! 

- 11 roleplay skins!
- Casual, cosplay attire inspired by games and gamers!

items.title: Construction 101
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
We build them up! And tear them down! We work till the sun goes down and make the city shine! Whatever the city needs, we can do it! Yes, we can!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Construction attire inspired by builders across the world!

items.title: Halloween Costume Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Looking for a treat this Halloween? Dress up in your favourite Halloween costumes perfect for teens looking to go out trick or treating.

+ Perfect for teens
+ Made for Halloween
+ Ideal for spooky roleplay

items.title: Dimensions
items.creator: Volcano
items.description: Explore three custom dimensions, solve puzzles and kill monsters. Visit the Ruby, Swamp, and Crystal dimensions now! Features custom music, custom mobs, and custom blocks.

items.title: Don't touch the color green!
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
You can't touch the color green otherwise you will die! Can you survive in your massive castle without touching any green blocks? Good luck!

+ Unique and fun challenge
+ Big castle
+ Multiplayer

items.title: DJ Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Create your own music with the new DJ Teens skin pack.

+ DJ teens
+ 1 free skins
+ 10 skins

Created by Mine-North
